d: Long, flowing strawberry blonde hair with straight-cut bangs and a red bow at the crown, paired with sharp, wide-open sky blue eyes. A youthful and mature appearance on a slender build. The outfit consists of a white sleeveless dress with a ruffled skirt, red accents at the neckline and waist, and asymmetrical white plated armor on the arms and left leg. Accessories include a brown leather belt with a small black scabbard and a large, red-and-gold ornamental banner held aloft.
